purpose: Common contract requirements of the review mechanism: round flow, handoff by review_id and round_number, finding_id numbering, write timing and exit values, body duties, and data structures.
summary: Overview and review flow: sequence of rounds between body, reviewer and evaluator, with termination conditions
FNC-314: each definition holds script usage and meaning of JSON items; no structure is carried in the request
FNC-302 to FNC-305, FNC-317: handoff only by review_id and round_number, scripts build inputs, values unchanged, request immutable and kind-free
FNC-313: finding_id is numbered by script as one sequence per review shared by reviewer and evaluator
FNC-310, FNC-311, FNC-203: write after judgments are finalized; exit value as string defines success; every finding must be referenced by an evaluation
FNC-312, FNC-316, FNC-318, FNC-204: body duties, retains_context branching, termination rules, flawed_premise excluded from auto-fix
DM-301: request structure with targets, focus, scope and references
DM-305, DM-302, DM-201: result, finding and evaluation structures with disposition, severity and confidence values
DM-304: absolute paths and location notation, with unknown location marked explicitly
tasks: Implementing review body script and agent handoff
Designing request, finding and evaluation JSON schemas
Designing exit value and error handling for agents
Implementing termination logic of review rounds
title: REQ-029 review 機構の共通契約 要件定義書
